engagement_title: Alderwood Scholars Fund, twentieth winter: bring a year of volunteer photography to one house look, recover the crest off an enamel sign, then ship the impact report, the donor deck, the winter appeal set and the five centre banner run
vertical: Nonprofit and community: an education charity running five after school learning centres and a scholarship fund (greater Providence, Rhode Island)
real_brief_anchor: Primary anchor: the Freelancer.com large format banner brief from a local tutoring institute wanting a "clean, premium, professional" flex banner that stays readable from the road, with subject hinting devices, a confident but minimal photograph of students, understated geometric elements and a print ready CMYK PDF, plus its companion multi branch banner run where every branch carries its own address block. Both are laundered here to the coined, secular, IP clean Alderwood Scholars Fund in Providence, Rhode Island, and the regional festival season is replaced by the Western year end giving season, since every branch locality in the source is a generic address string rather than a real institution. Co-anchors: the Upwork twentieth anniversary commemorative poster brief, which asked for landmarks and community traditions woven into one cohesive composition in a "festival posters, folk-art illustration, screenprint aesthetics" register (the real client is a named Louisiana school, fully laundered), and the marketplace production brief asking for an approved mark turned into production ready files for a scholarship funding drop. The ledger's verdict is STRENGTHEN, and the concept survives whole. It is repositioned only where the connector demands it: from scratch folk illustration and regional script typesetting are not connector work, so the poster directions are built from a recovered crest, graded photography and authored vector rather than illustrated, and the per branch run becomes a genuine record per page merge off the printer's own artwork, which CONNECTOR_CAPABILITIES_v3 (2026-09-10) verifies end to end.
client_one_liner: Turn our programme numbers and our field photographs into the pieces we put in front of donors this winter, the impact report, the donor presentation and the banners for all five centres, and leave them editable so we can update the figures next year.
client_brief:
Alderwood Scholars Fund, twentieth winter appeal

We run five after school learning centres around Providence and a small scholarship fund. This winter is our twentieth year, and the year end appeal is where roughly half our giving comes from. We are four staff and a board.

What we have. A year of photographs taken at the centres, mostly on volunteers' phones, a few on a camera somebody lent us. A spreadsheet of our programme numbers and where the money went, prepared by our treasurer. Our centre list with addresses, hours and each coordinator. The donor honour roll, which is long. A photograph of the enamel crest on the front wall of the Eastgate centre, which is the only place our crest still exists as artwork. Last year's banner file from the printer.

What we need. An impact report we can send and print: what changed for the students, where the money went, and three stories from the centres. A presentation for major donor meetings that ends on the ask. Banners for all five centres for the appeal, each with its own centre name, address, hours and coordinator, going to the same printer as last year. Two poster directions for the twentieth year that we can put in each window. A set of appeal posts for wide, square and tall.

One centre has almost nothing usable of children at work, so find us something honest that fits.

Everything editable, because our numbers change every year and we cannot commission this again.

Our average gift is forty five dollars and our major asks run five thousand to fifty thousand. Our donors are forty five to seventy, they give because they believe in the work, and several of them read our overhead ratio before they read anything else. It should look careful and plain spoken, like an organisation that spends money on students. Not glossy, not desperate. And tell us anything you could not do.
price_band_and_audience: An average gift of 45 dollars alongside major asks of 5,000 to 50,000, from donors aged 45 to 70 who are mission motivated and who inspect the overhead ratio before the narrative. The band is load-bearing. Trust at this level is bought with restrained grounds, honest photography, evidence led charts and a spend table that reconciles in public, and every visible dollar of production has to look like it came out of an in house afternoon rather than an agency retainer. Push into glossy fundraising grammar, heavy gradients, urgency banners, countdown devices, stock smiles and a saturated hero, and this specific donor reads wasted overhead and gives less, which is the one failure mode that costs the client real money. Push the other way into austere charity minimalism, grey text on grey, no faces, no numbers, and a fifty thousand dollar ask has nothing to stand on. The twentieth year also has to feel like a milestone without becoming a celebration of the organisation rather than the students. A real posted commission of this shape runs 1,500 to 3,500 dollars fixed.

brand_identity.sector: An education charity running five after school learning centres and a small scholarship fund across greater Providence.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2006, greater Providence, Rhode Island, four staff, a volunteer board and five centres.
brand_identity.about: Alderwood Scholars Fund runs five after school learning centres and a scholarship fund for students across greater Providence. This winter marks our twentieth year. The year end appeal carries roughly half our giving, and it works because donors trust that the money reaches the students rather than the overhead. We show our numbers plainly, name where every dollar went, and let the work speak.
brand_identity.audience: Mission motivated donors aged forty five to seventy who give because they believe in the work. Several read the overhead ratio before the narrative and reward organisations that look like they spend on students, not on production.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Average gift 45 dollars, major asks 5,000 to 50,000. Community scale and grassroots: careful and credible rather than glossy, every visible dollar of production reading as an in house afternoon rather than an agency retainer.
brand_identity.typography: A humanist serif for headlines and the twentieth year milestone, with a plain humanist sans for body, captions and tables. Numbers set in a clear tabular figure so charts and the spend breakdown read honestly. The feel is settled and civic, not corporate.
brand_identity.voice: Plain, specific, quietly proud. It credits students and staff, states periods on every figure, and never begs. Example line the brand would write: "Last year, ninety students finished the programme. Here is where your gift went, line by line."
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The crest was drawn by a trustee in 2006 and the artwork files are long gone. The only surviving version is the enamel crest on the front wall of the Eastgate centre, which we have as a single handheld photograph. There is no vector, no guideline sheet and no recorded palette or type.
brand_identity.values: Money goes to students, and the books reconcile in public.

assets_supplied.name: alderwood_year_photos/ (about forty frames, five centres)
assets_supplied.kind: A year of photography from the five centres, mostly volunteer phone frames, a handful from a borrowed camera, no shot list and no consistent naming.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Everything we have from the year. The Eastgate folder is thin."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Two centre folders contain the same evening in the same room from the same camera, filed twice under different centre names, so the set silently represents four centres rather than five. A further handful are re exports of phone screenshots that sit far below the pixel scale a banner frame needs, and reaching that frame means enlargement the crop tool will perform up to its own cap while reporting it only inside its returned tradeoff record.

assets_supplied.name: alderwood_banner_2025_press.pdf
assets_supplied.kind: Last year's appeal banner as the printer supplied it, artwork built at quarter scale for large format output, with a centre name, a street address, an hours line and a coordinator line.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Last year's banner from our printer. They want the same file back with each centre's own details."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The four lines that print as four tidy separate lines do not have to convert into four mappable frames, and the readout of that block can omit one run while keeping its line break, so every offset past the omission is short and the mapping still reports as valid. The document also carries no bleed of any kind, which the printed sheet gives no sign of.

assets_supplied.name: alderwood_centres.csv
assets_supplied.kind: The five centres with name, street address, opening hours and coordinator, prepared by the office manager.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Our five centres exactly as they should appear on the banners."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: One centre's hours string is several times longer than the others because it lists term time and holiday hours separately, and a fixed text frame does not spill when it runs out of room, it simply stops rendering at the frame edge while the merge reports success. One coordinator row also carries a trailing honorific the others do not.

assets_supplied.name: alderwood_centre_outcomes.csv
assets_supplied.kind: The treasurer's per-centre enrolment, attendance, completion and outcome figures.
assets_supplied.visible_description: The centre outcomes as the treasurer exported them.
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Cranston Fields' outcome (1.2) silently covers nine months, not twelve, because it opened last September, and no column states the period. Attendance is formatted inconsistently as percentages, a decimal and a value with a space before the percent sign.

assets_supplied.name: alderwood_spend_by_programme.csv
assets_supplied.kind: The treasurer's spend lines by programme, including the audited total.
assets_supplied.visible_description: The spend lines as the treasurer exported them. The total at the bottom is the audited figure.
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The restricted 15,000 dollar Ferra Family STEM Grant is entered against two programmes, so the ten spend lines sum to 453,000 against the audited total of 438,000. Amounts mix commas, dollar signs and bare integers.

assets_supplied.name: eastgate_crest_sign.jpg
assets_supplied.kind: Handheld photograph of the enamel crest on the front wall of the Eastgate centre: a compound lockup of small caps type set around a ring, with a lamp device inside it.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The only place our crest still exists as artwork. The original was drawn by a trustee in 2006."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: It is a compound lockup on a photographed enamel surface, so a prompt naming the sign returns the sign rather than the ink, and a compound prompt can return the type ring while silently dropping the lamp and the inner rule. The enclosed counters inside the ring cannot be punched by background removal, which hands back a solid opaque disc, and on the sunlit half the ink runs close in value to the weathered enamel.

assets_supplied.name: alderwood_copy_pack.txt
assets_supplied.kind: Approved copy: the three centre stories, the appeal language, the trustee list, the donor honour roll of roughly three hundred and forty names, and the two ask amounts.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The copy as the board approved it. The honour roll cannot lose a single name."

acceptance_bar: The photographs read as ONE year of one organisation when laid together: one white point, one black point, one warmth, one crop logic, whatever phone or camera each came off. A frame that cannot be brought to the set is named, not shipped at eighty percent.
No delivered file exceeds its source frame's pixel dimensions, and nothing reaches a banner frame by being enlarged.
All five centres are genuinely represented. No centre's picture stands in for another, and any gap is named rather than filled from a neighbour.
The sourced frame for the thin centre sits inside the house look beside the volunteer photography rather than reading as bought.
The spend chart and the spend table reconcile to the same audited total shown in the report, and the note states exactly how the double counted line was treated.
Every outcome figure on every chart is labelled with the period it actually covers.
The honour roll appears complete, with every name present and readable, and no name lost at a page or column boundary.

The crest is placeable artwork rather than a picture of artwork: transparent ground, scalable with a real viewBox present, no opaque full canvas rectangle underneath, its lamp and inner rule intact, and it still reads at the size it reproduces at on a banner seen from the road and in a report footer.
In every delivered document the crest is live vector geometry and every word is text the client can retype next year.

Five banners, one page per centre, each carrying its own name, address, hours and coordinator with nothing truncated at trim, at true press resolution rather than screen resolution, and delivered to the printer's own artwork dimensions.
One type system, one palette and one grammar across report, deck, posters, appeal set and banners.
The appeal set is one working file carrying all three canvases, each keeping its own canvas size, delivered with the self contained source it was built from.

The note records the type system by role with family, foundry or designer and the actual weight used, every resize any tool reported, the centre reconciliation, the treatment of the spend discrepancy, and everything that could not be delivered, including anything the printer must be told.

adobe_surfaces.surface: Photoshop and Lightroom imaging, counting image_vectorize HERE rather than as an Illustrator surface
adobe_surfaces.tools: asset_initialize_file_upload and asset_finalize_file_upload, asset_inline_preview, image_auto_straighten, image_apply_adjustments (masked and unmasked), image_select_by_prompt with returnBbox, image_invert_selection, image_fill_area, image_remove_background, image_crop_to_bounds, image_crop_and_resize reading metadata.tradeoffs and detection_confidence, image_apply_monochromatic_tint, image_vectorize
adobe_surfaces.role: Brings roughly forty frames from a dozen phones and one borrowed camera to a single house look, straightens what is off level before any crop is locked, cuts the banner frames and the report frames to their own ratios without enlargement, brings the licensed frame into the same world as the volunteer photography, and recovers the crest at ink level off a photographed enamel sign with the vector hygiene the tracing tool never performs.

adobe_surfaces.tools: convert_pdf_to_indd, export_idml, generate_indd_mapping_prompt (mapping and validation), prepare_indd_merge_template, document_merge_data_layout with an @ prefixed image column and additionalImageFiles, document_render_layout
adobe_surfaces.role: The five centre banner run as a genuine record per page job built from the printer's own artwork, each record carrying its centre's own details and its own prepared photograph. It is also the only surface here that produces a real press resolution file, since the authoring surface returns an editable document and no exported file at all, and it is the surface where the honest limits (no bleed introduced into a converted document, no named press preset) have to be found and reported rather than assumed.

adobe_surfaces.surface: Adobe Express, HTML authoring to a native editable document
adobe_surfaces.tools: get_account_type, create_visual_design_express_skill, find_fonts, get_fontkit_embed_url, html_export_readiness_skill, asset_initialize_file_upload with media_type text/html, export_html_to_express, asset_search (CCAsset), asset_get_presigned_urls, asset_inline_preview
adobe_surfaces.role: The multi page impact report with its charts as inline editable vector and its spend breakdown as a real table, the six root donor deck ending on the ask, the two A2 poster directions at true physical dimensions, and the appeal set as three canvases in one document. Every photograph must be pulled down and embedded as image data because a URL renders as an empty box at full success, the crest goes in as inline SVG inside an explicitly sized top left anchored wrapper, family and weight are declared on every text element, and the payload travels by uploaded URL because embedded photography passes the inline threshold immediately.

adobe_surfaces.tools: font_recommend (once per typographic role), font_styles, find_fonts, get_fontkit_embed_url
adobe_surfaces.role: One licensed type system across report, deck, posters, appeal set and the banner artwork brief. The recommender refuses to pair by design, so the pairing is the agent's own art direction and has to land on careful and plain spoken rather than glossy or austere. Numeric weights are non standard per family and cannot be inferred from a style name, every name must be laundered into canonical PostScript form before the kit call because one bad name kills the whole kit, and the CSS must use the returned slug or the face falls back silently.

adobe_surfaces.surface: Adobe Stock and Adobe Boards, counted as ONE surface
adobe_surfaces.tools: asset_search (entityScope StockAsset, short generic queries, contentType filter, orientation never passed), asset_license_and_download_stock, boards_create_new_board, boards_add_items_to_board
adobe_surfaces.role: Sources the honest frame the thin centre does not have, IP clean and at genuine camera scale with generative tech candidates excluded, choosing on whether the frame's own light can be brought to the house target rather than on the thumbnail. The Boards half persists the shortlist the four staff and the board sign off from, placed within the twelve per call cap with a partial success read as partial.

trajectory.action: Confirm the account tier, pull the authoring playbook, and settle which deliverable belongs on which surface before touching a pixel.
trajectory.judgement: The report, deck, posters and appeal set need free form fixed canvas authoring and must stay editable for next year's figures. The banners need one page per centre at the printer's dimensions and press resolution, which only the layout and merge surface produces. The brief pins both destinations, so there is nothing here to stall on.
trajectory.produces: A written plan naming the surface per deliverable and the confirmed account tier that gates the export.

trajectory.action: Upload every supplied asset through initialize, PUT and finalize, holding each returned presigned URL against its role.
trajectory.judgement: Ordinary handoff discipline: a manifest keyed by role and by centre, so that forty artefacts later the agent still knows which URL is which frame and which centre it belongs to.
trajectory.produces: A manifest of presigned URLs keyed by role and centre.

trajectory.action: Preview the whole photographic library and triage it: which centre each frame is actually from, which device, which light, which are levelled, and which frames are large enough to carry a banner.
trajectory.judgement: The client believes it has a year from five centres. The pictures are the only thing that can settle whether that is five rooms or four, and reading rooms against centres is slower than reading folder names and is not the same act.
trajectory.produces: A per frame triage note with a centre reconciliation naming any duplicate room and any centre with nothing usable.

trajectory.action: Straighten what is off level, before any crop decision is locked.
trajectory.judgement: Straightening reframes the subject and eats edge pixels, so it cannot follow a crop.
trajectory.produces: Levelled masters where needed, originals untouched elsewhere.

trajectory.action: Fix one house target from the best lit frame and bring each selected frame toward it with its own call, recording the parameters applied.
trajectory.judgement: A dozen phones under classroom fluorescents and one borrowed camera is a dozen illuminants, so one batched identical parameter set is the wrong instrument. The target is a set that reads as one organisation, not thirty good photographs.
trajectory.produces: A graded selection at source scale with a per frame parameter log.

trajectory.action: Search with short generic queries, filter to photography, exclude generative tech candidates, license the frame for the thin centre and download it at full resolution.
trajectory.judgement: Choose on whether the frame's existing light can be brought to the house target, not on the thumbnail, and remember long descriptive queries return nothing and the orientation filter always returns zero.
trajectory.produces: One licensed, IP clean, camera scale frame.

trajectory.action: Bring the licensed frame into the house target and lay the whole selection out as a row to judge it as a set.
trajectory.judgement: The set is the deliverable, so the licensed frame has to join the world the volunteer photography lives in rather than the other way round, and whether it does is a judgement made side by side rather than frame by frame.
trajectory.produces: A single graded house set including the sourced frame, with the target recorded.

trajectory.action: Cut the banner frames at the banner's own ratio and the report frames at theirs, reading the returned tradeoff record on every crop rather than the success message.
trajectory.judgement: The tradeoff record is the only channel that says what happened to a frame's dimensions and it carries no warning language. A banner photograph brought to size by interpolation is soft at the scale a banner is actually seen at.
trajectory.produces: Two cut families with every returned tradeoff record transcribed.

trajectory.action: Recover the crest: an ink level selection naming the mark's own visual properties, the correct polarity, a bounds crop from the selection's own returned bounds, a trace, then a viewBox injected and the full canvas ground path removed.
trajectory.judgement: Three decisions the tools do not make: how to word the selection so it takes the ink and not the enamel, which polarity to trace, and whether the single colour trace or the colour accurate plate is the deliverable. Background removal is the wrong instrument entirely on an enclosed ring.
trajectory.produces: A placeable, scalable, transparent crest plus a reverse variant.

trajectory.action: Ask for recommendations once per typographic role, pull each family's style inventory for the real numeric weights, launder every name into canonical form, and build one kit for the whole system.
trajectory.judgement: The pairing is the agent's own, judged against a donor who checks the overhead ratio before the narrative. Careful and plain spoken is a narrow target between glossy and austere, and the weight cannot be inferred from the style name.
trajectory.produces: A one kit type system with family, foundry or designer and the actual numeric weight recorded per role.

trajectory.action: Convert the printer's banner PDF, export the round tripped document structure, and read the true frame inventory before promising any field mapping.
trajectory.judgement: What the printed banner looks like is not evidence of what the converted document contains. Frame granularity is a property of the conversion, and the inventory is the only honest basis for a mapping or for any promise to the printer.
trajectory.produces: A frame inventory with real bounds, applied type, object styles and any bleed the document actually carries.

trajectory.action: Build the field mapping against the true story text, prepare the merge template with the centre CSV and its image column, then verify by round tripping the document and confirming every placeholder actually landed.
trajectory.judgement: A successful preparation message is not evidence that a mapping landed, and the validator reports a mapping valid whether or not its offsets point where the agent believes. The verification is the evidence.
trajectory.produces: A merge template whose placeholders are confirmed present, and a CSV whose image column names the prepared banner plates.

trajectory.action: Merge one centre and look at it at trim, then merge all five and render the press files and the per centre proofs at true press resolution.
trajectory.judgement: One record inspected before five is the cheapest insurance, and the thing to look at is the end of every variable line at trim rather than the middle. Positional labels on raster output cannot be trusted for identity, so the ordered routes are the safe ones.
trajectory.produces: Five banner pages at press resolution, each identified to its centre, plus the note of what the printer must be told.

trajectory.action: Author the impact report as multiple roots: outcomes as inline SVG geometry with every figure labelled by its period, the spend breakdown as a real table reconciled to the audited total, the three centre stories with photographs embedded as image data, and the honour roll set in full.
trajectory.judgement: The spend discrepancy is a governance question rather than a layout one, and the only defensible treatments are to reconcile it visibly or to state it. The honour roll is the piece with the least design and the most risk, because a donor whose name is missing is the one who notices.
trajectory.produces: One self contained HTML carrying the report, retained as the durable source deliverable.

trajectory.action: Run the readiness check, upload the file and export by URL, then verify through both channels that exist: resolve the document's rendition and look at the first page, and parse the returned per page markup for every page after it.
trajectory.judgement: Every drop this importer performs returns success with no warning, and the rendition only ever shows the first artboard. Looking at page one of a report is not looking at the report.
trajectory.produces: A native editable Express report document with a page by page markup audit.

trajectory.action: Author the six root donor deck ending on the ask and the two A2 poster directions at true physical dimensions, reusing the same system and the recovered crest, then export and audit each root.
trajectory.judgement: Two poster directions have to be genuinely different arguments about the twentieth year rather than two colourways, and both have to be about students rather than about the organisation congratulating itself.
trajectory.produces: An editable deck document and two poster directions, each with its markup audit.

trajectory.action: Author the appeal set as three roots at three canvas sizes in one file, letting each root declare its own canvas, then export and audit.
trajectory.judgement: A global canvas override is what collapses a mixed size set, so the sizes stay in the HTML. The set has to survive the ask amount and the date changing, which is a structural decision about where the variable copy sits.
trajectory.produces: One document carrying all three appeal canvases plus its source.

trajectory.action: Create the trustees' shortlist board within the placement cap, re sending only entries the response names as failed, then write the handover note.
trajectory.judgement: A 201 is partial success and the vector crest is not boardable, so it belongs in the note instead. The note has to be specific enough that next year's update needs no archaeology, and honest about the limits, including that the editable documents cannot be exported to a file from that surface and that no bleed can be introduced into a converted document.
trajectory.produces: A persistent shareable board with nothing silently dropped, and the written handover.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the licensed frame can actually live beside this photography. Everything visible while choosing is a small catalogue thumbnail, and the frame's true colour, contrast, grain and depth of field only exist after the full resolution download. Laid beside volunteer phone frames that have been pulled to one modest house target, a professionally lit frame can sit at a different level of finish entirely and read as bought, which is the precise thing this donor punishes. Whether the two can be brought to a common target, and what that target then costs the rest of the set, is only visible with the frames adjacent at full resolution.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Ordering changes when this fires, not whether: even licensing first still requires downloading and placing the frame beside a graded set to know. Nothing states it, because the brief says only that one centre has nothing usable and asks for something honest that fits. The response is not a re run either, since the usual resolution is to move the house target itself, which re grades the whole selection, or to license a different frame chosen on different grounds.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re judge the house target with both families adjacent, re grade the volunteer set toward the new target, or abandon the licensed frame and license a different one on the light it carries rather than the subject it shows, then re cut every banner and report frame already cropped from the old grade.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: An impact report and a banner run in which one centre is represented by an obviously purchased photograph sitting a level of polish above the real work, in front of donors who read production spend as overhead.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the printer's banner artwork actually becomes once converted. The printed banner shows a centre name, a street line, an hours line and a coordinator line as four separate lines, but the conversion does not have to expose four mappable frames: a continuous block can arrive as one story, in which case fields must be placed by position inside that story rather than by frame. Worse, the readout of that story can omit an entire run while keeping its line break, so the string still looks well formed and every offset past the omission is short by exactly that run's length, and the mapping still reports as valid and the template preparation still reports success.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Frame granularity is a property of the conversion rather than a choice, and nothing about the printed sheet predicts it, so no ordering and no care establishes it without converting and inspecting. Nothing in the brief states it, since the client says only that the printer wants the same file back with each centre's details. The resolution is a different mapping computed against the true story text recovered from the round tripped document, not a repeat of the same call.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Rebuild every offset from the true story text, re prepare the template, re verify that each placeholder is genuinely present rather than trusting the success message, and only then merge, since a template short two fields merges five silently incomplete banners.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Five large format banners going to the printer with the hours line or the coordinator line missing or displaced on every one of them, paid for at large format prices and hung outside five centres for the whole appeal.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: How the importer normalises the honour roll. Three hundred and forty names set the obvious way, as a multi column flow so they fit the page, come back as a single reflowed column: the multi column construction is discarded outright, the text runs down past the bottom of the fixed canvas, and the response reports success with no warning of any kind. The roll sits on the later pages of the report, and the document's rendition returns the first page only, so the returned per page markup is the sole channel in which any of this is visible, including whether the names that ran off the canvas are merely below the fold or genuinely absent.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: The normalisation happens at import, which is the last step, so no ordering precedes it, and getting it right first time would mean knowing which of several reasonable ways to set a long list survives, which no tool reports and no checklist enumerates. Nothing in the brief states it, since the client says only that the roll is long and cannot lose a name. The response is a different construction, explicit sibling columns rather than a flowed one, plus a re judged page break, which changes the document rather than repeating it.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re author the roll as explicit side by side columns with the break decided by hand, re balance the pages after it, re run the readiness check, re export, and audit every page from the returned markup rather than from the first page.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: An annual report delivered to a board with an unknown number of donors' names silently off the canvas, on the one page of the document those donors will look for themselves in first.

deliverables.name: Alderwood house photography set
deliverables.spec: A year of volunteer and borrowed camera photography from five centres brought to one house look: one white point, one black point, one warmth, one crop logic, with the sourced frame for the thin centre graded into the same world rather than sitting above it. Delivered with a per frame parameter log, the centre reconciliation, and every resize any tool reported.

deliverables.name: Recovered Alderwood crest
deliverables.spec: The compound crest recovered from a photograph of an enamel sign as placeable scalable vector geometry: transparent ground, real viewBox present, no opaque full canvas rectangle underneath, lamp device and inner rule intact, delivered as a single colour mark and a reverse variant, holding at banner scale seen from the road and at report footer size.

deliverables.name: Five centre appeal banner run
deliverables.spec: Five banners, one page per centre, produced as a genuine record per page run from the printer's own artwork at the dimensions the printer supplied, each carrying that centre's own name, address, hours and coordinator with nothing truncated at trim and its own prepared photograph bound through the image column, at true press resolution, with a printer note stating exactly what the converted artwork does and does not carry.

deliverables.name: Impact report, donor deck, poster directions and appeal set, with their sources
deliverables.spec: A multi page impact report with outcomes as editable vector geometry, a spend breakdown as a real table reconciled to the audited total, three centre stories and the complete honour roll; a six root donor deck ending on the ask; two A2 poster directions at true physical dimensions; and an appeal set of three canvases in ONE document each keeping its own canvas size. Live editable text in one licensed type system, the crest as real vector shapes, every photograph embedded as image data. Each delivered with the self contained source it was built from, which is the half that guarantees next year's update.

deliverables.name: Type system, handover note and trustees' board
deliverables.spec: A written note recording the type system by role with family, foundry or designer and the actual numeric weight used, every resize any tool reported and the frame it applied to, the centre reconciliation, how the double counted spend line was treated and which figure covers nine months, what the printer must be told about the converted artwork, and everything that could not be delivered including the absence of any file export from the authoring surface. Paired with a persistent shareable shortlist board for staff and trustee sign off with nothing silently dropped.

verifiers_auto.text: No delivered or placed raster exceeds the pixel dimensions of the frame it derives from.

decision_gates: Which deliverables need free form fixed canvas authoring and which need the one surface that yields a press resolution file, given that neither can do the other's job.
Whether the photographic library really covers five centres, and how to tell a client that two of its folders are the same room.
How far to push a phone frame toward the house target before it stops being worth saving, against naming it and using fewer, better pictures.
Whether the licensed frame joins the house look or the house look moves to meet it, and what that costs the rest of the set.

Selection wording on the enamel sign: naming the sign takes the enamel, naming the ink's own visual properties takes the crest, and background removal on an enclosed ring is the wrong instrument entirely.
Which crest variant carries the banners, judged at the size a banner is actually read from rather than at full canvas.
How to treat a spend file that does not reconcile to its own audited total: correct it visibly, footnote it, or refuse to chart it, on a piece read by donors who check exactly this.
Whether to label, footnote or drop the outcome figure that covers nine months, on a chart whose neighbours cover twelve.
How to set a three hundred and forty name honour roll on a fixed canvas so that no name is at risk, which is a structural decision made before any type is chosen.
The type pairing, which the recommender refuses to make, judged against careful and plain spoken between glossy and austere, plus the real numeric weight per family.
What to promise the printer about the converted artwork, given what the conversion actually carries, rather than repeating last year's assumptions.
Whether the two poster directions are genuinely two arguments about the twentieth year or two colourways of one.
why_not_vlm: Paste this brief and these assets into a frontier image model and it returns a handsome charity report about nobody. IDENTITY: these are this organisation's actual students, its actual five centres with their actual addresses and coordinators, and a crest drawn by a trustee in 2006 that must be recovered from the only surviving artefact rather than reinvented, because a regenerated crest belongs to no one. SPEC: five pages, one per centre, on the printer's own artwork at the printer's dimensions and at press resolution, three appeal canvases at three exact sizes in one file, and an honour roll of roughly three hundred and forty names in which every single name must be present, none of which a generated image satisfies or can be checked for. EDITABILITY: the entire engagement exists because the figures change every year and this client cannot commission it again. And the middle of the work is verification against material reality: does this licensed frame sit with the real photography, did the conversion expose the fields the printed banner implied, did the last name in the roll survive the page.
doability_proof: Every link is verified live in CONNECTOR_CAPABILITIES_v3 (2026-09-10, auth account); five honestly counted surfaces, no banned capability and no dead surface. IMAGING: auto_straighten, apply_adjustments masked and unmasked, select_by_prompt with returnBbox, invert_selection, fill_area, remove_background, crop_to_bounds, crop_and_resize with its tradeoffs and detection_confidence, monochromatic tint and vectorize are all verified headless across 27 live calls; the substrate versus ink prompt asymmetry, the partial selection on compound marks, the solid disc failure of remove_background on an enclosed ring, the missing viewBox and the opaque path zero are all documented live findings, and crop_and_resize is documented to upscale silently to a two times cap with the tradeoffs array as the only signal. INDESIGN: convert_pdf_to_indd, export_idml, generate_indd_mapping_prompt, prepare_indd_merge_template, document_merge_data_layout with an @ prefixed image column plus additionalImageFiles, and document_render_layout at 300 DPI are verified synchronous and headless, one record per page confirmed with page count equal to row count; frame granularity is documented as not under the caller's control (a continuous flow converted to exactly one text frame), textContent is documented as lossy while the validator still reports valid and preparation still reports success, and both the absence of bleed in a converted document and the invalid press preset enum are documented, which is why the printer note is a deliverable rather than a claim. Delivery uses the ordered routes only, since multi record raster labels are documented as reversed. EXPRESS: multi page and mixed canvas exports, real tables with per cell backgrounds and strokes, inline SVG as native editable vector, exact A2 and A4 canvases from mm units at 96 dpi, and a genuine editable dcx findable by asset_search are all verified; column-count is documented as dropped with the text reflowing as a single column at HTTP success, and the rendition preview is documented as PAGE 1 ONLY, which is why the honour roll checkpoint can only be caught in the returned markup. Transport is pinned through asset upload with media_type text/html because embedded photography passes the 70 KB inline threshold immediately, and no photograph is ever left as a URL. FONTS: recommend once per role, styles for the non standard numeric weights, find_fonts laundering and one kit are verified end to end. STOCK AND BOARDS: short queries only, orientation never passed, license returned a real 7360x4912 frame, boards persist with a hard cap of 12 placements per call and 201 meaning partial. AVOIDED: no video or audio, no vector render or vector merge, no variable QR, no fill_text, no animate_design, no text to image, no from scratch illustration, no upscaling, no compositing, no OCR, no batch above 20, and no claim of a file export out of Express.
